Right so I rarely have any dreams (I know technically I have a lot but I don't remember them) and today had the first one in a while. It was like a movie, some dreamy edgy shit with impossibly good for me situations and in the end me and my ex get back together. We broke up around a month ago, I thought I'd be over it by now. I don't want to tell friends about this but I'm a bit worried.

I'm reminded of Cormac McCarthy's "the Road." In it he points out that bad dreams are an expression of perseverance in a struggle, while good dreams signify emotional forfeiture. Taking psychology lessions from fiction is dubious, but so is anything else you'll read on dream interpretation. While good dreams feel great (so great you'll tell strangers), they show you your own defeat. Liken it to poor people plotting out how to spend nonexistent lottery winnings. But good dreams can be useful in mapping priorities, and love is still a great one by me.
